skill.name: gaffa-debug
skill.description: Diagnose failing browser automation and scraping requests using Gaffa recordings or supplied scripts, then suggest targeted patches and optional capture-enabled reruns.
skill.summary: Classify browser automation failures and recommend minimal fixes from request evidence.
skill.author: gaffaai

security_audit.summary: Static alerts match Markdown formatting, documented API operations, credential safeguards, and consent-gated remote page captures. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration, host reconnaissance, or embedded prompt injection. A conditional exact-key redaction rule can leave credentials in unstructured output when the entropy threshold is not met.

remediation.issue: Exact-key scrubbing is skipped when the credential does not meet the entropy threshold.
remediation.suggestion: Always redact a known nonempty credential before displaying or persisting output. For short values, suppress ambiguous output rather than skipping protection.

semantic_findings.title: Conditional Redaction Can Expose Known Credentials
semantic_findings.description: Exact-key scrubbing requires at least 16 characters, a digit, and a letter; otherwise the skill says to skip it and warn. Credential-field scrubbing remains, but a known key in an unstructured trace or unnamed payload can remain visible or be persisted.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly disables exact-key scrubbing when the threshold fails. No actual leaked credential is shown, and field-name redaction still offers partial protection.

content.user_title: Debug Browser Automation with Gaffa Request Evidence
content.value_statement: Browser automation failures can be difficult to explain from error messages alone. This skill reviews scripts and Gaffa request evidence to classify failures and suggest minimal fixes.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve Gaffa browser request results using a supplied brq_* identifier.
Classify API misuse, selector changes, bot protection, timing failures, and unsuitable extraction actions.
Recommend schema corrections, narrower parsing inputs, cache changes, and request timeout adjustments.
Propose one optional rerun with recording, DOM capture, and screenshot capture after explicit confirmation.
Review non-Gaffa scripts and offer a Gaffa-based alternative when no recording exists.
Apply credential-field redaction rules before displaying or persisting diagnostic payloads.
limitations: Gaffa request retrieval requires network access and a configured GAFFA_API_KEY.
Recordings may be missing or expired, and request results do not include the original body or action configuration.
Reruns and recordings consume credits; proxies require a paid account, and target-site restrictions may remain unresolved.
Exact-key redaction has an entropy-based exception; review diagnostic output for secrets before sharing.

use_cases.title: Repair a Failing Scraping Script
use_cases.description: Review an extraction failure and identify the smallest schema, selector, or action change supported by the evidence.

use_cases.title: Investigate Browser Request Timeouts
use_cases.description: Compare request timing and action results to recommend waits or timeout adjustments within the account limits.

use_cases.title: Explain Missing Extraction Results
use_cases.description: Distinguish empty outputs, stale cache results, and unavailable recordings before recommending an approved diagnostic rerun.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Failed Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Gaffa request ID [brq_*]. Explain the likely failure and the evidence available. Do not rerun it.

prompt_templates.title: Check an Extraction Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this script and its empty extraction result: [script and error]. Suggest the smallest fix, and identify missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect a script without a useful recording

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Diagnostic Rerun
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a capture-enabled rerun for [request ID or script]. Show the credit estimate and redact credentials. Wait for my explicit confirmation before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Nested Action Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these sanitized request results and script: [evidence]. Inspect nested loop outputs, cache settings, schema shape, and timing. Recommend a minimal patch without executing it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: diagnose several interacting failure signals

output_examples.input: My extraction action failed, but I only have the request result.
output: Likely cause: an invalid extraction schema or excessively broad page input.
Evidence limit: the request result does not include the submitted schema.
Next step: provide a sanitized script or request body before choosing a targeted patch.

output_examples.input: The request completed, but the expected action output is empty. No recording exists.
output: Likely cause: a changed page structure or an incorrect selector.
Available evidence cannot distinguish these causes without a fresh capture.
Proposed next step: estimate a capture-enabled rerun and wait for explicit confirmation.

output_examples.input: The request result shows a cache hit, but I expected fresh data.
output: Likely cause: cached content was accepted by the request settings.
Suggested patch: disable cache reuse for this request.

best_practices: Provide the request identifier and a sanitized script or request body when action parameters are needed.
Approve diagnostic reruns only after reviewing the credit estimate and confirming authorization to capture the target page.
Inspect sanitized output for remaining secrets, and disable recordings in shipped code when debugging ends.
anti_patterns: Assuming the request result reveals original action parameters that the API does not return.
Running capture-enabled retries repeatedly without approval or a credit budget.
Sharing raw recordings, cookies, or error traces without checking redaction.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a Gaffa brq_* request identifier or a failing script. Include sanitized error details and the expected result.

faq.question: Can it review scripts that do not use Gaffa?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews the supplied script and offers a Gaffa alternative, but it cannot retrieve a Gaffa recording for that script.

faq.question: Will it rerun requests automatically?
faq.answer: No. Reruns default to off and require an estimated credit cost plus explicit developer confirmation.

faq.question: What happens when a recording is missing or expired?
faq.answer: It explains the evidence gap and recommends an optional capture-enabled rerun. Recording retention depends on the Gaffa plan.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Gaffa API calls require GAFFA_API_KEY in the environment. The instructions prohibit hardcoding, printing, or persisting the credential.

faq.question: Is diagnostic output guaranteed to contain no secrets?
faq.answer: No. Credential-field scrubbing is required, but exact-key matching has an entropy threshold. Review all diagnostic output before sharing or saving.
